verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that Obsidian stores notes as non-proprietary, plain-text Markdown files on the local device. They also say these files can be edited with other editors and that this explicitly lets your data outlive the app. Users independently confirm they own their files and that their plain-text notes can outlive Obsidian, and Canvas uses JSON files. Missing for 10: default Wikilinks are a non-standard extension that must be switched to Markdown links for full interoperability, and there is no evidence that the Canvas JSON format is publicly documented as an open spec.
